title: Introduction to rbiodatacr
text: rbiodatacr R client querying BIODATACR, national biodiversity information platform Costa Rica managed Technical Office CONAGEBIO. platform built Atlas Living Australia (ALA) API infrastructure.
code: library(rbiodatacr) library(dplyr) library(sf) library(ggplot2)

title: Introduction to rbiodatacr
text: downloading occurrence records, use bdcr_species_search() verify species name recognized BIODATACR retrieve taxonomic identifier (GUID). function may return one row species subspecies registered. guid column contains unique identifier taxonomic concept — useful precise queries.
code: bdcr_species_search("Panthera onca") #> # A tibble: 2 × 7 #>   name        guid  commonName scientificName rank  taxonomicStatus nameComplete #>   <chr>       <chr> <chr>      <chr>          <chr> <chr>           <chr>        #> 1 Panthera o… 5219… ""         Panthera onca… spec… accepted        Panthera on… #> 2 Panthera o… 5219… ""         Panthera onca… subs… accepted        Panthera on…

title: Introduction to rbiodatacr
text: Use bdcr_count() check many occurrence records available downloading. multiple species use bdcr_count_batch(), returns tidy tibble one row per species.
code: bdcr_count("Panthera onca") #> [1] 313 species <- c(   "Tapirus bairdii",   "Panthera onca",   "Ara ambiguus",   "Bradypus variegatus" )  conteos <- bdcr_count_batch(species) conteos #> # A tibble: 4 × 2 #>   taxon               n_records #>   <chr>                   <int> #> 1 Tapirus bairdii             1 #> 2 Panthera onca             313 #> 3 Ara ambiguus             1216 #> 4 Bradypus variegatus      4151

title: Introduction to rbiodatacr
text: bdcr_occurrences() downloads records single species returns tibble 15 fields relevant biodiversity analysis. multiple species use bdcr_occurrences_batch(), returns named list tibbles — one per species.
code: df_jaguar <- bdcr_occurrences("Panthera onca", rows = 100) glimpse(df_jaguar) #> Rows: 100 #> Columns: 15 #> $ scientificName   <chr> "Panthera onca subsp. centralis (Mearns, 1901)", "Pan… #> $ vernacularName   <chr> "Central American Jaguar", "Jaguar Panthera onca", "J… #> $ decimalLatitude  <dbl> 10.91970, 9.95000, 10.47563, 10.68948, 10.48542, 10.5… #> $ decimalLongitude <dbl> -85.01460, -84.00000, -83.46852, -84.14154, -83.81592… #> $ year             <int> 1993, NA, 2021, 2013, 2013, NA, 2013, NA, 2022, 2013,… #> $ month            <chr> "06", NA, "12", "06", "04", NA, "10", NA, "05", "09",… #> $ basisOfRecord    <chr> "PreservedSpecimen", "PreservedSpecimen", "HumanObser… #> $ dataResourceName <chr> "Modelado de la distribución geográfica de mamíferos … #> $ country          <chr> "Costa Rica", "Costa Rica", "Costa Rica", "Costa Rica… #> $ family           <chr> "Felidae", "Felidae", "Felidae", "Felidae", "Felidae"… #> $ species          <chr> "Panthera onca", "Panthera onca", "Panthera onca", "P… #> $ collector        <chr> "NO DISPONIBLE", "Ch. d'Eternod", "UACFel (SINAC-Pant… #> $ license          <chr> "other", "other", "other", "other", "other", "other",… #> $ geospatialKosher <lgl> TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE,… #> $ taxonomicKosher  <lgl> TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE,… spp_with_data <- filter(conteos, n_records >= 10)  lista_occ <- bdcr_occurrences_batch(   taxa = spp_with_data$taxon,   rows = 100 )  # Number of records per species purrr::map_int(lista_occ, nrow) #>       Panthera onca        Ara ambiguus Bradypus variegatus  #>                 100                 100                 100

title: Introduction to rbiodatacr
text: bdcr_quality_check() adds quality_flag column occurrences tibble. Possible flags : Keep clean records:
code: df_qc <- bdcr_quality_check(df_jaguar)  count(df_qc, quality_flag, sort = TRUE) #> # A tibble: 1 × 2 #>   quality_flag     n #>   <chr>        <int> #> 1 ok             100 df_clean <- filter(df_qc, quality_flag == "ok",                          !is.na(decimalLatitude),                          !is.na(decimalLongitude)) nrow(df_clean) #> [1] 100

title: Introduction to rbiodatacr
text: Convert clean tibble sf object plot records Costa Rica.
code: # Convert to sf df_sf <- st_as_sf(   df_clean,   coords = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"),   crs    = 4326 )  # Load Costa Rica national boundary included in rbiodatacr # Source: GADM (gadm.org), level 0 = country boundary data(cr_outline)  # Map ggplot() +   geom_sf(data = cr_outline, fill = "gray95", color = "gray50") +   geom_sf(data = df_sf, color = "#E63946", size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +   labs(     title    = "Panthera onca — BIODATACR occurrence records",     subtitle = paste0(nrow(df_sf), " clean records"),     caption  = "Source: BIODATACR (biodiversidad.go.cr)",     x = "Longitude",     y = "Latitude"   ) +   theme_minimal()

title: Introduction to rbiodatacr
code: # 1. Check availability species <- c("Tapirus bairdii", "Panthera onca",              "Ara ambiguus",    "Bradypus variegatus")  conteos <- bdcr_count_batch(species)  # 2. Download species with enough data con_datos <- filter(conteos, n_records >= 10)  lista_occ <- bdcr_occurrences_batch(   taxa = con_datos$taxon,   rows = 200 )  # 3. Quality control lista_limpia <- purrr::map(lista_occ, bdcr_quality_check)  # 4. Consolidate and filter df_final <- bind_rows(lista_limpia, .id = "taxon") |>   filter(quality_flag == "ok",          !is.na(decimalLatitude),          !is.na(decimalLongitude))  # 5. Summary df_final |>   count(taxon, sort = TRUE) |>   rename(clean_records = n) #> # A tibble: 3 × 2 #>   taxon               clean_records #>   <chr>                       <int> #> 1 Panthera onca                 200 #> 2 Ara ambiguus                  199 #> 3 Bradypus variegatus           199

title: R Client for the BIODATACR Biodiversity Data Platform of Costa Rica
code: library(rbiodatacr)  # Check data availability bdcr_count("Panthera onca") # Download occurrence records df <- bdcr_occurrences("Panthera onca", rows = 50) dplyr::glimpse(df) # Query for multiple species species <- c("Tapirus bairdii", "Panthera onca", "Ara ambiguus") counts  <- bdcr_count_batch(species) counts # Quality control df_qc <- bdcr_quality_check(df) dplyr::count(df_qc, quality_flag, sort = TRUE)

title: R Client for the BIODATACR Biodiversity Data Platform of Costa Rica
code: library(rbiodatacr) library(dplyr)  # 1. Explore data availability species <- c("Tapirus bairdii", "Panthera onca",              "Ara ambiguus",    "Bradypus variegatus")  counts <- bdcr_count_batch(species)  # 2. Download species with sufficient data with_data <- filter(counts, n_records >= 10)  occ_list <- bdcr_occurrences_batch(   taxa = with_data$taxon,   rows = 200 )  # 3. Quality control and consolidate df_final <- purrr::map(occ_list, bdcr_quality_check) |>   bind_rows(.id = "taxon") |>   filter(quality_flag == "ok",          !is.na(decimalLatitude),          !is.na(decimalLongitude))  # 4. Summary df_final |>   count(taxon, sort = TRUE) |>   rename(clean_records = n)

title: Quality check for occurrence records — bdcr_quality_check
text: df `tibble` occurrence records (output `bdcr_occurrences()`). min_year Integer. Minimum acceptable year. Default 1950.

title: Quality check for occurrence records — bdcr_quality_check
text: `tibble` additional `quality_flag` column.   Possible values: `"ok"` issues detected. `"no_coords"` Missing coordinates. `"geospatial_issue"` `geospatialKosher == FALSE`. `"taxonomic_issue"` `taxonomicKosher == FALSE`. `"old_record"` Year `min_year`.

title: rbiodatacr 0.1.0
text: First release CRAN. bdcr_count(): count available records taxon. bdcr_count_batch(): count records multiple taxa. bdcr_occurrences(): download occurrence records taxon. bdcr_occurrences_batch(): download occurrence records multiple taxa. bdcr_species_search(): search taxonomic information BIE index. bdcr_quality_check(): evaluate record quality assign flags.
